sentences.en: We were present at the dedication ceremony of the building.
sentences.zh: 我们出席了这座建筑的落成典礼。

sentences.en: My enthusiasm and dedication are at an all time high.
sentences.zh: 我的热情和投入达到了前所未有的高度。

sentences.en: Hard work and dedication will bring you success.
sentences.zh: 努力工作和全心投入将带给你成功。

senses.zh: 奉献,献身 - 献身精神 - (书等作品上的)题词,献词
